summary: Implemented GeneralizedWassersteinDiceLoss in monai/losses/dice.py (class after GeneralizedDiceLoss, four helper methods, forward returning batch mean, alias generalized_wasserstein_dice), exported it from monai/losses/__init__.py, and added tests/test_generalized_wasserstein_dice_loss.py with binary 2D and empty-class tests (correct and flipped logits, with and without a size-1 channel in the target). Nothing was run, per instructions; expected values are from hand calculation. Only line over 120 columns is pre-existing at dice.py:36. Changes are uncommitted. A float64 numpy distance matrix makes the loss float64, which follows the spec's dtype rule but was not verified.
